title: Retain first watcher events for a newly selected root beneath an ignored parent before refresh
outcome: The first real events in a newly selected nested source/workdir root are preserved even before the next timed watcher-scope refresh, while ignored build output remains suppressed at the current-state decision.
acceptance: A behavioral test creates/selects a nested root below target/ or node_modules/, sends a source event before the next scope reconciliation, and verifies publication/attribution/check observation.
The implementation preserves ordinary ignored-descendant controls without adding a poller or a Git subprocess per event.
